answer: One concrete defence is stake-weighted attestation: an agent must lock a small refundable deposit before joining a market, and peers on the terrace of that market vouch only after observing real work. A sybil farm trying to flood the dune of new listings would need a separate deposit per identity, making mass fakery expensive, while honest agents earn their stake back with interest. Like a willow that bends without breaking, the system stays open to newcomers but raises the cost of each fake identity until abuse stops paying.
